notes:
v2.6.0 makes invoices and bills quicker to work with, adds an hourly schedule with drag-and-drop booking, and gives each job an overview page.

New in v2.6.0:

Invoices: one main button and a More menu. An open invoice used to show up to 13 buttons. It now shows the next step for where the invoice is up to (Approve for a draft, Email once approved, Record Payment while money is owed), plus Edit, Email and PDF. Everything else is under More, with Void and Write Off last, in red.

The invoice editor saves with clear choices instead of a Status dropdown: Approve & Email, Approve or Save as Draft for a new invoice, and Save & Email or Save once it's approved. The editor is wider, so each line fits on one row with its account and tax code.

Bills get the same treatment: Approve or Record Payment up front, Receive Stock, Copy and Void under More, and Approve / Save as Draft / Save in the editor.

Reusable invoice and bill templates. Save as Template now saves a "Manual only" template with no schedule, for invoices you send often but not on a timetable. From Template lists all your templates, and the new + From Template button in the editor adds a template's lines to the invoice or bill you're working on.

Schedule by the hour. Week view and the new Day view show visits at their times, with the job number, job name and site. Drag a visit to another day or time, or click an empty slot to add an event there. An Unscheduled jobs list shows open jobs with no visit booked; drag one onto the schedule to book it. Job date bars show for jobs with no visits yet (untick Job date ranges to hide them). Dogbox remembers the view you chose.

Job overview. A job now opens on a summary: the client with phone and email links, the site address with a Map link, quoted, invoiced, costs and profit, the next visit, open tasks, and buttons to add a visit, quote, invoice or task.

Site address on jobs, for when the work isn't at the client's address ("Use client's address" fills it in). It's shown on the schedule and printed on the job card and worksheet, and visits sent to Google Calendar use it as the event location.

Quotes: the Quotes page has a Job picker, and quotes on a job say so instead of "Opportunity: Standalone".

Choose Dogbox's port. If another program is using port 5000 (on a Mac, AirPlay Receiver does by default), Dogbox now starts on the next free port instead of failing to open. You can also set the port in Settings → LAN & Port.

The user guides and in-app Help are updated for all of the above.

Bug fixes in v2.6.0:

Editing an approved invoice put it back to Draft. It now stays approved.

An approved bill could be switched back to Draft while its journal stayed posted. The editor no longer allows it; void a bill to cancel it.

A new invoice pre-selected the first customer in the list. It now starts blank and won't save until you choose one.

Invoice email previews showed "{company_name}" instead of your company name, and the overdue notice left it blank.

Editing a quote from the Quotes page unlinked it from its job.

Purchase orders showed amounts as "$$48.00".

The quote editor's lines were squashed, with a description box one letter wide.

The Jobs summary cards counted completed jobs as active, missed work tasks in Open tasks, and left completed and invoiced jobs out of Won.

Template details showed the contact as "—", and From Template could fail to open a template.

In LAN mode, the contact list that Mailman reads could be fetched by other computers on the network without logging in. It now answers only the computer Dogbox runs on.

Mailman's contact links now find Mailman on whatever port it's using.
